'''Junken''' was the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Stisste/Legends|Stisste]] in the [[Saleucami system/Legends|Saleucami system]], located in the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Junken was a [[Temperature/Legends|searing]] rock without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Saleucami system/Legends|Saleucami system]], except [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
